key_insight: AI can help decode and mitigate instability in 3D inorganic CsPbX3 perovskites by linking degradation mechanisms to prediction and design strategies.
engineering_relevance: The review frames AI as a practical tool for improving device reliability under thermal, chemical, optical, and electrical stress in perovskite solar-cell and optoelectronic engineering.
evidence_signal: The abstract emphasizes that existing studies are limited by multimodal data, coupled degradation pathways, protocol dependence, sparse statistics, and uncertainty quantification, motivating AI-driven analysis.
watch_item: Current AI results may not transfer well across labs or devices because benchmark quality, protocol consistency, interpretability, and domain transfer remain major challenges.
paper_title: Artificial Intelligence for Instability in Inorganic Perovskites: From Mechanism Discovery to Engineering Strategies
